feature: Settings (#1736, Feature #1596) — the consolidated Settings container page in artifacts/portal, per the landed Shell design's own settingsGroups/stab state machine (Design/portal/design_handoff_full_site/screens/Shell.dc.html:1418-1450). Six tabs, three groups: ALERTS (Alert preferences, Notifications), YOUR TENANT (Email authentication, Webhooks, Departments), YOUR ACCOUNT (Privacy and your data). Change Control, Ownership/RACI and Account Security are deliberately NOT part of this page — the landed design keeps each on its own dedicated destination, contradicting the earlier #4057 contract-pack framing. Route: /settings. This manifest covers the new container (nav, tab switching) and the two brand-new tabs (Alert preferences, Departments); Webhooks/Notification Preferences/Email authentication/Privacy already have their own manifests covering their standalone routes and are only smoke-checked here for correctly rendering inside the container.
notes: shaneapp://runTest hits the DEPLOYED build, not the local worktree — these assertions only go green once this session's commit is deployed by the dev-server rebuild.
ENV VARS required: DEPLOY_URL, TEST_CUSTOMER_EMAIL / TEST_CUSTOMER_PASSWORD — the same Customer testbed account test-manifests/portal/webhooks.json already uses.

RULES-1 is the new portal-facing route this build added — GET /api/portal/alert-preferences/rules, a read of the customer_tenant_alert_rules catalog (previously admin-only, zero customer-facing consumers). Asserted directly since it has no prior coverage anywhere.
DEPT-1 confirms the already-built (but previously zero-consumer) GET /api/portal/settings/departments contract this page's new Departments tab now wires — real, possibly-empty array, never a fixture.

UI steps click through all six tabs to confirm the container's real stab-switching renders each real tab content component (not a placeholder), reusing each tab's own already-established data-testid (alert-preferences-content, departments-content, webhooks-page, notification-preferences-page, email-auth-setup-page, data-rights-and-privacy-page — the last of which this build added since the standalone page had none before).

The testbed tenant currently has zero users with a department attribute set (confirmed live via psql this session), so UI-DEPT2 asserts the real, honest empty state rather than a populated row — that is the correct assertion for current data, not a gap.

Departments' 'Edit mapping' / group-mapping form and Alert preferences' save/reset/recipient round-trip are NOT driven destructively here — the shared testbed tenant's real alert-preference rows and department mappings are used by other flows (customer-tenant-alert-engine, ownership-workload-membership), and this manifest's job is proving the container wires real data in, not re-proving each tab's own save contract a second time.
